rows.en: A handsome young man with a somewhat brooding air.
Deep down, he has quite a hot-blooded streak.
He can be rather brusque and foul-mouthed, though it doesn't bother him.
He is athletic and handles most sports with ease.
That ability comes from the grueling training at his grandfather's dojo
that he endured as a child.
"However painful childhood experiences may be, they become treasures later in life."
He may be a fine example of that saying.
He is an only child. His parents were caught in a terrorist bombing at an airport
and killed. Afterward, he lived with his pet cat, Yamato.
Then, without warning, he became caught up in
an anomaly in causality that all but forced him
to travel to another world, Agarthia.
What will he see there, and what will he feel?
The answers have yet to be found...
He was closely involved in activating Rayblade, the Spirit Mech sealed in the Holy Land,
and has also been aboard it.
Pilot of the Spirit Mech Rayblade.
He handles the main controls.
Pilot of the Spirit Mech Vishal.
Like Touya, she was caught up in an anomaly in causality.
...Though she doesn't seem particularly bothered by it.
An utterly carefree, happy-go-lucky high school girl.
When she does get depressed, however, she sinks very low indeed.
She plans things out carefully when they hardly matter,
yet acts before she thinks precisely when it counts.
Either way, she doesn't think very far ahead.
She isn't shy around strangers and has a special talent
for making friends with anyone.
Perhaps starved for her family's affection, she is easily won over by kind words
and quick to fall in love. She can be surprisingly old-fashioned, too.
She had a faint crush on Touya, but
Kasumi's arrival may make her begin to recognize
her true feelings... Or perhaps it won't.
It turns out she actually attends an all-girls school.
She seems to have a bit of a crush on Touya, but...
A gifted alchemist regarded as
one of the Holy Land's most promising talents.
Her current title is Chief First-Class Scholar
of the Holy Alchemical Society.
She was also among the first to sense signs of Ze=Ode's return
and sound the alarm.
She takes part in the Spirit Mech Development Project
by providing technical support.
Gentle as an angel, she has a pure and generous heart.
She looks very mature,
yet sometimes reveals a rather childlike side.
Men might find her an exceptionally endearing woman.
She falls in love quite easily, but reason holds her back from taking the plunge,
and her fear of being hurt makes her
put an end to those feelings without ever acting on them.
She tends to lose her nerve at the crucial moment, fail,
and then hate herself for it.
She is in fact the daughter of Wenimas Latia,
one of those responsible for the Terror of Ze=Ode
109 years ago. Learning the truth leaves her shaken,
but encouragement from her companions helps her regain her composure
and resolve to face it.
Then Lyle, now revealed to be her father, dies before her eyes
while protecting her, plunging her into profound grief.
Yet the bond with her companions that she had felt growing
through all their battles helps her find her feet again.
She emerged with a firm resolve in her heart,
and the face of a warrior.
Touya's childhood friend. She is reserved and good at looking after a home.
She is also shy, quiet, and reluctant to come out of her shell.
A childhood friend, glasses, long straight black hair, quiet devotion...
She certainly ticks quite a few boxes.
Apparently, though, she loses sight of everything around her when she snaps.
Since Touya's parents died in an accident, she has
looked after him even more devotedly than before, and harbors
special feelings for him. For now, she keeps them
tucked away in her heart,
but they are painfully obvious to everyone else.
Perhaps out of habit since childhood, she still calls him
"Touya-chan."
Like Touya, she is caught up in an anomaly in causality
and ends up in Agarthia.
Pilot of the Spirit Mech Orbest.
Pilot of the Spirit Mech Hongshenguang, the Crimson Flash.
A man devoted to justice who prizes the chivalrous code.
By nature, he is extremely courteous.
He is demanding of others and equally hard on himself.
For better or worse, he is a warrior through and through.
Two and a half years ago, he met Melissa when they were summoned together
and they became lovers. During Spirit Mech training, however, they were caught
in a skirmish with Zigrim, and Melissa went missing.
Ever since, the thoughts "I couldn't save her. I abandoned her"
have bound him in remorse and left him a man of few words.
Pilot of the Spirit Mech Baldock.
He was also the first pilot selected for the current
Spirit Mech Development Project. A former Brazilian Air Force pilot,
he once served with the Smoke Squadron aerobatic team.
He is generally cheerful and friendly,
and quick to make a pass at women. But that is only his outward face.
Surprisingly, he cannot handle a single drop of alcohol.
Apparently, drinking sends him straight to sleep.
He grew up in poverty and has had more than his share of hardship.
He dislikes cats, particularly black ones,
though nobody knows why.
After losing his wife and child in an accident, he left the military.
Later, while living alone,
he became caught up in an anomaly in causality
and found himself in Agarthia.
A hot-blooded young man who tends to get carried away by his own convictions.
An old-fashioned code of chivalry was drilled into him
from childhood, shaping the person he is today.
Recently, though, he has begun to take it
in a somewhat different direction.
His Prana level is high for a native of Agarthia,
and in that one area, his natural gifts are virtually unmatched
within the Knights of the Kingdom of Agarthia.
Once he gets an idea into his head, he loses sight of everything else
and charges straight ahead.
People like him are simple souls, and easily fooled.
He lost his parents in the accident that revived Ze=Ode three years ago.
Afterward, Major Rest of the Agarthian Army, his swordsmanship instructor,
took him in.
He is utterly helpless around older women and admires those
who are quiet and delicate.
He seems to have feelings for Ymir, but...
The arrival of Ymir's junior colleague, Emy,
shatters his tender hopes of romance.
...Yet meeting Kasumi mends his broken heart in no time.
New feelings begin to blossom...
Pilot of the Armored Mech Mireon.
Pilot of the Spirit Mech Dusseldorf.
A redheaded girl with braids and freckles.
She is always looking after others and never minces words.
Having lost her parents when she was little, she has spent years
looking after her younger brother, Gen.
Perhaps that explains her oddly strict and overbearing streak.
During a terrorist incident, Rayblade happened to destroy her shop.
She boards the Liebhofen to collect compensation from Touya
and earn enough to get by.
She works mainly as the cook, but handles all sorts of odd jobs with ease.
Rosalie's younger brother. Energetic and fond of pranks.
He is quite a cheeky brat. Being lovable anyway must be a child's privilege!?
Even so, he wouldn't dare stand up to his sister Rosalie.
He is self-conscious about being short.
His full name is so long that people usually just call him "Gen."
Ever since he saw Touya in the news about Rayblade's activation,
he has looked up to him with fierce admiration.
Following the incident in the royal capital, he boards
the Liebhofen with his sister Rosalie.
He dreamed of becoming a Spirit Mech pilot
and kept a sharp eye out for his chance.
His hard work and natural aptitude were eventually recognized,
and he became the pilot of the Spirit Mech Zeifon.
Pilot of the Spirit Mech Parikar.
Beautiful, but with a cold, unapproachable air.
People often think she is older than she really is.
She is actually quite friendly and has a playful side,
but her tendency to keep people at a distance
makes it difficult for her to find friends.
She loves small animals. Her attitude changes so completely around them
that she seems like a different person. Though she hasn't realized it,
she also seems to prefer older partners.
Pilot of the Spirit Mech Drydes.
Calm and collected. He is highly intellectual as well as physically gifted.
He is also a talented cook who serves up delicately flavored dishes.
Usually inconspicuous, he serves as the group's voice of reason
and a source of wise advice.
In short, he is the unsung hero supporting everyone behind the scenes.
Only Clovis has been in Agarthia longer than he has.
Perhaps because they get along so well, the two often spend time together.
The daughter of Forzen and Paldia, and Ymir's niece.
Quietly affectionate. Her hobby is apparently fortune-telling...
She gives everything her best effort and has a heart
capable of caring deeply about others.
She is so kindhearted that she isn't quite sure how to approach people,
which makes her a little shy around strangers. Yet with Touya,
she felt at ease right away.
She greatly respects Ymir and, inspired by that admiration,
studies alchemy. Her real gifts, however, lie less in alchemy
than in her natural aptitude as a pilot.
She also played an active role as a test pilot
in the Spirit Mech Development Project.
Paldia apparently knew nothing about this.
She also has a hopeless sense of direction, the sort that sends her
in exactly the opposite direction from her destination.
She joins the Liebhofen's crew
and becomes the pilot of the Spirit Mech Forstin.
A girl whose appealing features are her unruly hair and eyes brimming with curiosity.
She is simplehearted and, for that very reason, utterly straightforward.
An outstanding athlete, she is much stronger than she looks.
She took part in the research on Ze=Ode.
In her case, though, she was neither a collaborator nor an assistant.
Instead, she was treated as a substitute to be used in experiments.
Unaware of this, she cooperated
with the single-minded wish to be useful.
The distortion in space-time caused by the explosion 109 years ago
threw her forward to three years before the present, where she has lived since.
She is Eleana's pilot.
She is Debish's daughter, but was apparently treated very poorly.
Now, however, she has become one of Touya's companions.
She is not an ordinary human after all, but
a human being created artificially.
Though distraught, she is persuaded by Touya
to try to forge new bonds.
However...
Grad's daughter.
She isn't shy with strangers, but has so little experience of being scolded
that she doesn't know how to handle anger directed at her
and sometimes runs away.
Usually bright and lively, she is lonely at heart.
She is interested in romance and eagerly gathers information from books and elsewhere.
Her favorite phrase is "You perv!"
She joins the Liebhofen's crew
and becomes the pilot of the Spirit Mech Forstin.
A mature woman with a calm manner and an air of elegance.
She was summoned two and a half years ago alongside Xiujian and Aurelie.
She and Xiujian met then and became lovers,
but during Armored Mech training, she was caught in a conflict with Zigrim
and her mech was shot down.
She escaped the wreck, only to collapse from her injuries,
and was rescued by Dr. Baio.
Thanks to his care, she survived, but
perhaps because of the terror of battle, she lost all memory
of her time in Agarthia. Since then,
she has worked as a test pilot for Dr. Baio's Armored Mechs
while living with him.
Xiujian's words restore her memories,
and she returns to the man she loves.
Pilot of the Spirit Mech Ahti.
Touched by Dr. Baio's kindness, Melissa chooses
to stay. He is sincerely happy, yet he knows
that it cannot last forever.
Even so, he chooses to remain with her,
if only for a little while.
Until the moment Melissa realizes that what she feels is pity,
rather than love.
A princess of Agarthia, and an absolute machinery fanatic.
Women have no claim to Agarthia's throne. That,
combined with her natural temperament, let her grow up free of restraint.
Full of curiosity, she wants to stick her nose into everything.
She is frank, open, and refreshingly straightforward.
More often found in work clothes than a dress,
she never strikes anyone as a princess at first meeting.
Brilliantly intelligent, she handles everything from designing Spirit Mechs
to programming computers.
Aboard the Liebhofen, she finds one excuse after another
to help service the machinery herself.
The mechanics place great trust in her.
Pilot of the Spirit Mech Selphin.
Crown Prince of the Kingdom of Agarthia.
First in line to the throne of Agarthia.
A fine young man with a strong sense of responsibility and a gift for taking action.
Despite his position as crown prince,
he is easygoing and unconcerned with formalities.
His one flaw is his utter lack of restraint where women are concerned.
Rumor has it that he has lovers everywhere,
and apparently those rumors aren't entirely baseless...
He accepted Ymir's warning that Ze=Ode would return
and launched the Spirit Mech Development Project.
The younger brother of Lodis and Celica. Quiet, kind, and exceptionally intelligent.
Second in line to the throne of Agarthia.
He deeply respects his older brother Lodis,
yet envies him at the same time.
He secretly has feelings for Queen Alforina of York.
A cat Touya found shortly after she was born and has lived with ever since.
Though of mixed breed, she has a glossy coat
of which she herself(?) seems rather proud.
She used to sneak into Touya's bag every day
and accompany him to school.
When Touya was summoned, she came to Agarthia
along with him.
Touya cherishes her as family, rather than as a pet.
After she was gravely injured and underwent extensive resuscitation surgery,
Gabon's kindness(?) left her able to understand and speak human language,
a cyborg cat with intelligence on a human level.
For some reason, though, she says "nya" whenever she means "na."
Always by Touya's side, she understands him well.
She seems to think of herself as his older sister.
She knows more about Agarthia and the Spirit Mechs than Touya does.
A knight of York bearing the title "Sword Radiance,"
which denotes the strongest knights in Agarthia.
He wields an immense sword nearly twice his own height
and can overpower an Armored Mech without piloting one himself.
It is said that the only person who can match him in combat is
Marie Christil, another holder of the Sword Radiance title.
Of all the knights who hold that title,
Garyud alone appears in public,
so he can be called the strongest warrior on the continent.
Every knight aspires to be like him, regardless of nationality.
A knight of York's royal guard, one of the so-called Three Sword Knights.
Known as Reduce the Silver,
his movements on the battlefield are likened to a silver wolf.
With his speed and destructive power, he has repelled countless threats
and helped defend York.
Earnest by nature, he believes in fighting fairly and openly.
A knight of York's royal guard, one of the so-called Three Sword Knights.
An enormous knight with a gentle heart.
At the palace, he can always be found tending the flowers.
The flowers blooming in the gardens are the fruits of his hard work.
He judges situations calmly and sees the bigger picture:
a knight with the makings of a commander.
It would be no exaggeration to call him York's military strategist.
A knight of York's royal guard, one of the so-called Three Sword Knights.
Her hair and eyes are the color of molten rubies,
and her fierce-looking features and slender figure
bring a predatory cat to mind.
She feels an aversion toward men.
Perhaps that explains why there has never been a whisper of romance about her,
a fact that clearly worries her father, Garyud.
In her own words, "I have no intention of getting married."
It seems Garyud will have plenty to worry about for some time yet.
It is revealed that she is descended from both the former ruling house of Falmight
and the royal house of Istarsh.
To everyone's surprise, she and Alforina
turn out to be cousins.
Now that Queen Alforina has fallen to an assassin's blade,
Ciel is chosen as the new leader.
The son of Grand Duke Gaharin Lang Mestina,
who was the younger brother of Reginal Lang Mestina.
He was not born to Gaharin's lawful wife, however, and is an illegitimate child.
After his father Gaharin, his greatest protector,
died, hostility toward him within the court
grew stronger, leaving him increasingly isolated.
At that point, Crown Prince Lodis reached out to him.
From then on, they lived as the closest of friends.
Until the day Lodis's words made Rayfon shut his heart
against him...
Later, Rayfon volunteered for an investigation team. When Ze=Ode revived,
he was caught in the explosion and presumed dead.
In fact, he was caught in the space-time distortion opened by the blast
and lost between moments of time. There he encountered a disembodied mind
named Grauzer, who was also wandering that void.
Grauzer saved his life in exchange for a body and a place for his consciousness.
Rayfon retained his own sense of self
while sharing his existence with Grauzer's consciousness. Now, the two minds
have fused.
Grauzer designed the Ultra-Offensive Shell Units known as Shinkaio.
He is an alien from the planet Lin Karma, rather than Earth.
As the pilot of the Shinkaio Aidion,
he fought a desperate battle against Vorlia with two companions
4,000 years ago, then slept in the void between moments of time.
A colonel in the Agarthian Army.
Marshal Revios's devoted right-hand man.
Fiercely patriotic and conscious of his elite status, he would not hesitate
to give his life for Agarthia.
He is better at intrigue within and beyond the organization than frontline combat.
A lieutenant colonel in the Agarthian Army.
An officer personally groomed by Marshal Revios.
He has sworn absolute loyalty to the marshal.
Extremely belligerent.
He seems to have feelings for Rosalie,
but she pays him no attention whatsoever.
A major in the Agarthian Army.
He is not merely one of the kingdom's finest Armored Mech pilots,
but one of the greatest knights on the continent.
He also holds the Royal Knights' sacred rank of "Phoenix,"
a title awarded to Agarthia's most outstanding knight.
He is famous as the only knight to have studied under
Marie Christil, a Sword Radiance knight. There are even rumors
that they were lovers.
He values honor and duty, and holds himself to lofty ideals.
Fain's mentor, and as close to him as an older brother.
Three years ago, he took in Fain after the boy lost his parents.
Incidentally, he seems to be in an intimate relationship
with the freelance journalist Maki.
Outwardly, she is a girl with clear azure eyes and brown skin.
In fact, she is an alien from the planet Lin Karma.
Together with Grauzer and Valga, she fought a desperate battle
against Vorlia on Earth 4,000 years ago.
Afterward, she was flung to Linga, a remote island in Earth's southern seas,
where she was revered as a messenger of the gods. Eventually,
unable to maintain her physical form, she sealed her consciousness
inside her own Shinkaio, Coolmarishin,
and went to sleep in preparation for Vorlia's eventual return.
Now, 4,000 years later, Valga has awakened her.
Borrowing the body of Mana Elua, a girl from the island who served as a priestess,
she sets off for Agarthia.
Mana's own consciousness lies almost entirely dormant.
Though Mana grew up beneath the southern sun with a bright,
bubbling energy, Rishuna's gentle,
modest personality instead gives her
the air of a woman wrapped in mystery.
A mysterious old man.
An alien from the planet Lin Karma.
Together with Grauzer and Rishuna, he fought a desperate battle
against Vorlia on Earth 4,000 years ago.
Unlike the other two, he was not flung anywhere
and maintained his physical existence.
After helping stabilize Agarthia and restore Earth's environment,
he went to the far side of the moon to prepare for Vorlia's return.
There, together with his Shinkaio, Sivarius,
he entered a long sleep.
Though he spent those quiet years in suspended animation,
4,000 years was still quite enough
to turn him into an old geezer.
Even so, the fact that he still retains his original body
is astonishing. Awakened by Goderius's appearance,
he descends to Earth to wake his two companions,
who are still asleep.
Rishuna must have been quite surprised when they reunited
and she saw that Valga had become an old man.
Apparently he used to be a cool young man. Now he's just a dirty old man.
The central figure behind the Terror of Ze=Ode
109 years ago.
He devised a plan to use Ze=Ode to accelerate human evolution
and lead humanity to a new stage.
During the explosion 109 years ago, his body alone was destroyed,
leaving him a disembodied consciousness.
When he was flung forward to three years before the present, he could not simply
disappear. Instead, he summoned a vessel with his thoughts:
Dei, whose body he merged with.
Pilot of Goderius.
The father of Sharl and Leone.
In fact, Debish no longer acts as himself, though his own consciousness still exists.
During the activation experiment 113 years ago, he came under the control
of an Estelian consciousness that had been sealed
inside Goderius.
An alchemist who agreed with Debish's plan and joined him.
Blind from birth, she can now see thanks to artificial retinas.
Even so, she does not rely on her sight,
and rarely shows her eyes.
She is Debish's most loyal assistant
and believes everything he says without question.
The space-time distortion caused by the explosion 109 years ago
flung her forward to three years before the present, where she has lived since.
Pilot of Parthenos.
Debish's daughter and Leone's older sister.
She seems to have sensed some change in her father
since the day of Goderius's activation experiment, but...
Even now that she knows everything, she is prepared
to sacrifice herself for Debish.
A person surrounded by a strangely mysterious air.
He tends to be offensively polite,
though apparently that is simply his natural manner.
An alchemist whose talents caught Debish's eye 115 years ago,
leading him to join the research on Ze=Ode.
He went on to participate in Debish's plan as well.
His specialty is bioengineering.
The space-time distortion caused by the explosion 109 years ago
flung him forward to five years before the present, rather than three.
He used that two-year head start
to put his own designs into effect.
Unbound by human ethics, he acts according to his own values.
Faithful to his own feelings and judgments,
he may risk his life to save someone one day,
and kill someone without the slightest change of expression the next.
Nobody can fathom the workings of his mind.
Pilot of Gaiozon.
Pilot of Rayode.
He joined the research on Ze=Ode
through an introduction from Wenimas.
Rather than an alchemist, he was a self-taught researcher
of the human mind. A natural genius of sorts,
he never learned to put in much effort.
Unfortunately, his natural physical gifts also led him
to develop a habit of acting
before he thinks.
Still, his knowledge and understanding rivaled an alchemist's,
and he apparently made a major contribution to the research.
He and Wenimas were lovers. But when Wenimas and his younger brother Lenis,
who had also joined the project, seized Rayblade
and challenged him to battle, he began to suspect their relationship.
Those suspicions turned into a dark jealousy
that took deep root in his heart.
Upon learning that Wenimas had never betrayed him, however,
he is overcome with regret. Then, to protect his daughter Ymir,
he sacrifices his own life.
Perhaps he was a man who lived for love to the very end...
A general in the Republic of Zigrim's army.
He is effectively the head of the military, and his influence is said
to exceed even the president's.
Small in stature, but full of energy.
At heart, he is a soldier brimming with patriotism,
yet he is no blind fanatic. He has the judgment
to know what must be done. Friendly enough to share a drink even with a private,
he has earned the soldiers' deep trust.
He apparently has a personal feud with President Horem
and refuses ever to meet him face-to-face.
He also seems to be an old acquaintance of Dilma Jin Revios,
marshal of the Kingdom of Agarthia.
A major in the Republic of Zigrim's army.
As Zigrim's military modernizes,
he is known as its last knight.
Called the Lion of the West, he has admirers
far beyond Zigrim and is held up as
a model of knighthood.
Until recently, he had left the military and lived with his wife and daughter.
He returned to service as if to coincide with the invasion of York.
A lieutenant colonel in the Republic of Zigrim's army.
A fiercely independent woman, hard on herself and on others.
She had resolved to remain single all her life. Lately, though,
that no longer seems quite so certain. Perhaps because she grew up poor,
she is rather thrifty and meticulous.
Apparently, she dislikes slovenly men and frivolous, grinning men.
A first lieutenant in the Republic of Zigrim's military.
A cheerful, friendly man overflowing with talent.
He is a genius at winning people over.
He is good at drawing others into his own rhythm.
Behind that manner, however, lies cool-headed judgment.
He is making advances toward Commander Fores,
but she pays him no attention.
His favorite phrase is "Quite right, quite right."
In fact, he was a test subject in a top-secret human enhancement project
once conducted in Zigrim, commonly known as Code 3.
A mark that will never fade has been branded
into his neck, and even now he continues to take
powerful tranquilizers.
A captain in the Republic of Zigrim's army.
Zigrim's problem child, belligerent and obsessively vindictive.
His mind works just like that of a selfish child
prone to tantrums.
Even so, he is a skilled pilot whose achievements in battle
earned him his present rank.
He is a despicable man who will use any means to reach his ends,
yet he also has a warrior's love of
fighting stronger opponents.
Eleven years ago, he tried to assault Grad's wife.
Grad gave him the scar that runs across his cheek.
He still nurses a misplaced grudge over it.
Director, chief designer, and accountant
of Zigrim's Designant Armored Mech workshop.
In other words, he owns a private workshop whose only employee is himself.
Since manufacturing is outsourced to other workshops,
he mainly handles design and prototype construction.
He has absolute confidence in his own talents
and has devoted his life to developing the strongest Armored Mech.
He never tires of declaring himself a genius,
but in truth, he is a man of hard work.
He dislikes letting anyone see the effort he puts in, however.
His personality is rather frivolous.
Shy around women, he is still single.
He is also the man who rescued Melissa after she lost her memories
and nursed her back to health.
In time, he begins to feel something for her that goes beyond
their partnership in research, but...
Always dressed in black,
he is known as the Black Prince:
the second prince of the Principality of Limberg.
He has now been disinherited as a prince of Limberg.
He was at the scene of the explosion three years ago
and went missing in its aftermath.
When he appeared again, the frail boy of three years earlier
had grown into a young man brimming with confidence.
Before being disinherited, he had studied in Agarthia,
where he was close to Celica and Tix. He especially admired Rayfon
as an older brother and was always at his side.
They seemed like real brothers, or perhaps shared a bond
stronger even than that.
In fact, he was a clone created by Bernst.
The original was injured beyond any hope of recovery in the explosion three years ago
and was discarded during the cloning process.
His implanted memories are identical
to the original's. Unable to forgive Lodis for hurting Rayfon,
he resolved to take revenge on Rayfon's behalf, weaving one scheme after another
for that purpose alone.
After his death, the Principality of Limberg issued no official statement.
Apparently its king, Fram Zeo Isfandeil, considers that Cain ceased
to have any connection to their country
the moment he was disinherited.
The third son of a noble family
of middling rank in the Kingdom of Agarthia.
A patron of the terrorist organization Dawn of an Era.
At heart, he is a coward incapable of doing anything on his own.
His place in Dawn of an Era has nothing to do
with his own abilities. They are interested solely
in his parents' wealth.
Needless to say, he hasn't realized this himself.
Field commander of the terrorist organization Dawn of an Era.
He once commanded a unit in Venir,
a mercenary force of the Principality of Limberg.
An upright military man, he ignores slander
against himself, but refuses to tolerate insults toward his subordinates,
no matter who is responsible.
This made him unpopular with his superiors, but earned him
the deep trust of his men.
He has successfully carried out several famous operations,
and his skill as a tactician is beyond doubt.
Dei once saved his life.
His devotion to Dei led him to join Dawn of an Era.
She also holds the title of secretary to Dei Rakbal,
chairman of the Agarthian Council.
A woman with a mature, sensual allure.
She is Dei's partner in both his public and private life.
Having survived countless battles alongside Dei,
she is a mercenary of proven skill.
She is also skilled in hand-to-hand combat and has successfully
assassinated important figures on numerous occasions.
Naturally, she also makes use of a woman's powers of seduction.
He is fairly sharp,
but his naturally short temper wastes that intelligence.
He was born into the family of a scholar famous in his field,
but a certain incident tore the family apart.
After a troubled boyhood, he joined Dawn of an Era,
where he remains today.
For some reason, he and Barkin seem to get along well.
A man who overestimates his own strength.
He is a good man at heart, but his very innocence
makes it hard for him to find his way through life.
He had a younger sister, but she died in a certain incident.
Because of that incident, he has secretly continued
sending money to a certain orphanage.
To the children, he was a kind older man.
A hardened fighter who once made a name for himself
as a mercenary alongside Render.
Devoted to duty, this veteran speaks only when necessary.
A rather timid man. He gets along well with Kinari.
His distinguishing feature is his lack of distinguishing features.
A newcomer at the very bottom of the ranks. He originally belonged
to Ioannis's circle of hangers-on.
While many of the others left Ioannis,
he alone stayed, for some reason. In that sense,
he may be the only person who truly understands him.
Leader of a notorious mercenary band said to side with anyone
who offers enough money.
Once he has signed a contract, however, he never betrays it.
Every member has an unusually high Prana level for an Agarthian
and can pilot an Armored Mech with ease.
As a result, countries everywhere prize their services.
He was once the foremost knight among the sacred ranks
of Agarthia's Royal Knights. But battle became
so ingrained in him that only while fighting
could he feel his own existence.
Nobody knows that he is now
the commander of a mercenary band.
Rosalie and Gen's biological father.
His true name is Gaizardingterius Jin Mercene.
He is commonly called Gaius.
Tough and wild, he seems to have been born
for the sole purpose of becoming a mercenary.
He can live only in battle. The worse the situation,
the more his abilities shine: a man who thrives on adversity.
In ordinary life, he is quite a gentleman.
He falls for Ymir and proposes to her, but...
He can be a little hotheaded, but is generally
a calm man.
A skilled tinkerer, he met Vales while working in the scrap business
and was the one who introduced
Vales and Jono to each other.
His skills are good enough to win even Celica's approval,
though nobody would guess his talent from his appearance.
Lately, he has been a little concerned about his growing belly.
The rank-and-file soldiers who belong
to the terrorist organization Dawn of an Era.
Among them is a person called "Subordinate" who accompanies Barkin,
but they have all been lumped together here.
That's how minor enemies have always been treated, then and now.
The Liebhofen's engineer and ship's doctor.
A stubborn old man. Unusually for an Agarthian,

He has a large scar on his left cheek, which he apparently keeps
as some sort of reminder to himself.
His wife and child have died.
Apparently he was a renowned mercenary in his youth,
but he does not like discussing it.
He is the one responsible for turning Yamato into a cyborg cat.
Incidentally, an "imposing figure" means someone
whose body and facial features are unusually large
and powerfully built.
The Liebhofen's communications officer. She is also a qualified physician.
Her face always seems to be smiling.
Gentle and personable, she is good at looking after others.
Through Rest's recommendation, she joined
the Spirit Mech Development Project.
However, she was a test subject in Code 3,
a human enhancement project secretly pursued in Zigrim
and later sealed away. When she pilots an Armored Mech,
she transforms into a terrifying fighting machine.
Three years ago, Miyasco ran out of control during an experiment
and crossed into Agarthia.
She fought Rest, then a captain assigned to border security,
and became an Agarthian prisoner. But when Rest learned
of Zigrim's inhumane project, he took her under his protection.
With help from Lodis and Ivel as well,
she gained citizenship in the Holy Land. Though haunted
by recurring nightmares, she tried to find
an ordinary daily life. A mark that will never fade
is branded into her neck, and the wounds in her heart remain unhealed.
The Liebhofen's helmsman.
Despite his large build and intimidating face, he is gentle at heart... or rather,
somewhat timid.
He dislikes hurting others or being hurt himself,
and naturally grew into a man of few words. Hard as it is to imagine
from his physique, he is actually better at mental work.
Apparently, he wanted to become an alchemist,
but joined the military at his parents' strong urging.
He never found a good opportunity to quit, and remains there today.
The Liebhofen's navigator, who also serves as gunnery officer.
A large, rotund man whose pockets
always contain something to eat.
Despite that, he is apparently surprisingly nimble.
His ability to concentrate in brief, intense moments is remarkable,
and his shooting skill astonishes even York's famously elite artillery troops.
That talent earned him his place on the crew.
"What he says usually makes sense,
but somehow, hearing it from him just ticks me off!" (Ai)
...He's that sort of person.
Amazingly enough, he is currently engaged.
(Her name is Sefia Iyul, age 19.
A pretty young woman and his childhood friend.)
The Liebhofen's purser.
He handles operational records and accounting.
He has the air of a rather dapper older gentleman.
Meticulous by nature, he has a keen head for money.
He has dubious connections and a knack
for finding supplies seemingly out of nowhere.
Rumor has it his slogan is "Everything from underwear to missiles."
The Liebhofen's radar operator.
Though she looks younger than her age, she is a spirited girl.
She is actually a palace lady-in-waiting assigned to the crown prince
and a huge fan of Lodis. On learning that he was helping
with the Spirit Mech Development Project,
she maneuvered behind the scenes and worked hard to join. However...
Lodis's position prevented him from sailing aboard the Liebhofen,
and her ambition came to an abrupt end.
For now, she seems content simply to help
make Lodis's ideals a reality.
An excellent cook, she is also in charge of the galley.
Her hair, tied in buns, is her charming trademark.
There are also rumors that she is a daughter of a distinguished family.
A former soldier of York.
Captain of the mobile carrier Liebhofen.
After leaving the military, he enjoyed a comfortable retirement
and apparently turned down Lodis's invitation at first.
How he nevertheless came to be
the Liebhofen's captain remains a mystery.
An eccentric who usually says nothing but "Hmm."
Yet those who know his past hold him in high regard
as a renowned commander... apparently.
Queen of York. Unmarried. Both of her parents are deceased.
She admires Crown Prince Lodis of Agarthia and spared no effort
in committing her country's support to his Spirit Mech Development Project
against Ze=Ode.
She is also the one who summoned Touya and the others to Agarthia
for their protection. Gifted with foresight,
she takes an interest in Touya's future.
Her hobby is making sweets.
Though she wished for true peace in Agarthia,
she loses her life to Oswald's murderous blade.
Touya and many others
carry on her final wishes.
A veteran knight of York and an old comrade of Captain Roa.
He also taught swordsmanship to Garyud in his younger days.
Though apparently, rather than teaching combat techniques,
he taught him the proper mindset.
The highest authority in the Holy Land.
She gives the impression of a kindly grandmother.
She knows about Ymir's past.
The current king of the Kingdom of Agarthia.
He understands his role well and always strives
to set an example for his people.
A quiet king with a scholarly disposition.
His wife, Ipha Laniard Mestina, died nine years ago.
He took a hands-off approach to raising his children,
but lately has been regretting it.
(Apparently, he has Celica in mind.)
Recently, he has often been confined to bed by illness.
Agarthian. Female. Died at 36. The late queen of the Kingdom of Agarthia.
Mother of Lodis, Celica, and Tix, who died nine years ago.
She sincerely wished for peace in Agarthia.
Deputy commander of the Agarthian Army's general staff.
He holds the rank of marshal.
With almost no experience of actual combat, he tends
to put theory first. He is thoughtful and mild-mannered.
Fiercely patriotic, he is growing exasperated with the corruption
of Agarthia's parliamentary government.
He is a believer in Pax Agarthiana,
peace under Agarthia.
Head of the Gazette Project.
An authority on genetic engineering who conducts research
at the Brufle Artificial Evolution Research Institute.
He never bothers to remember people's names.
His research follows his own personal tastes to a remarkable degree,
and when his experimental subjects run out of control,
they cause no end of trouble for everyone else.
He is always complaining about a lack of funding,
and rightly so, though he still somehow manages to make ends meet.
Generous in spirit and a little laid-back.
Officially, he is a scholar attached to the Holy Land
who studies the other world, Earth.
His real job, however, is as a negotiator who selects and persuades
people from other worlds with high Prana levels.
An intellectual fluent not only in the languages of Agarthia,
but also Japanese, English, French, Chinese, and Portuguese:
five languages from Earth.
Even when talking to Touya, he was speaking for himself,
rather than relying on an Adjuster.
Incidentally, there are several negotiators like him,
and some are apparently stationed in Touya's world.
Ymir's older brother and Melvi's father.
Forzen's wife and Melvi's mother.
She is Ymir's sister-in-law.
Even more easygoing than Forzen, she has a gentle disposition.
Her hobbies are cooking and entertaining guests. Apparently, her pies
(sweets made by laying fruit on a flat pastry base,
adding butter and syrup, then baking them in an oven)
are exquisite.
Lately, she has been worrying about when Ymir will finally
find someone special.
When Ymir brought Touya home, Paldia mistakenly thought
she had finally found a boyfriend, much to their embarrassment.
A beautiful woman with short hair.
An acquaintance of Fain and Miyasco.
A freelance journalist with a wealth of sources,
she dreams of winning the Roguewar Prize,
something like the Pulitzer Prize. Prone to grandiose ideas and jumping the gun,
she is utterly convinced that there is always more to a story than meets the eye.
Rayblade's revival sparks her interest in the Liebhofen's activities,
and she begins following its crew around.
She owns Reisuke, a computerized camera
of which only five exist in the world.
Her relationship with Rest of the Agarthian Army goes beyond lovers, but stops short of marriage.
A scientist with an older twin brother, Lyle. Through Wenimas's introduction,
he joined the Ze=Ode Project with his brother 100 years ago.
Unlike his brother, he is gentle and somewhat conservative. He admired
Wenimas. Originally Rayode's pilot, he sympathized with Wenimas's fears
about activating Ze=Ode. To stop the plan,
he seized Rayblade and fled with Wenimas.
They chose Rayblade because it was convenient for the two of them
to escape together. But an accident during their flight killed Wenimas
and triggered an unstable activation of Ze=Ode, sending the other members
of the Ze=Ode Project through time. Lenis was thrown from Rayblade
at that moment. Instead of traveling through time, he was affected
by spatial displacement and transported to the surface.
Unable to return to Agarthia, he lived out his life there.
Touya is his descendant.
She demonstrated the existence of a phenomenon in each Ze=Ode unit:
the resonant induction of consciousness.
Using it, she discovered a clue to their activation.
She joined the project as Debish's assistant.
In private, she and Lyle were lovers.
Alarmed by Debish's plan, Wenimas sought
the help of Lenis, who shared her concerns.
To stop it, they seized one of the plan's key components,
Rayblade, and challenged the others to battle together.
Amid the confusion, the plan was forcibly set in motion,
causing a massive explosion. This was the Terror of Ze=Ode
that occurred 109 years ago.
Having become a disembodied consciousness, she searched for people
with high Prana levels and an affinity for Spirit Mechs,
so that she could stop Debish's plan. She was also the one
who steered Touya and the others toward Agarthia.
Yet had she not acted, humanity in Agarthia
might have perished, with the consequences eventually reaching
Touya's world as well.
The so-called final boss.
This being comes from Estelia, a place far beyond the galaxy,
in a universe unknown to us.
Freed from the fetters of time,
he can apparently create even the future itself.
Living for eternity, drifting through an aimless daily existence,
he happened to glimpse an outside world.
Its lives, bound by time, captivated him,
and eventually he acted to place himself among them.
In the end, he was defeated by mutual trust... by bonds.
He vanished.
Having learned that even those who are individually weak can grow strong
by believing in and accepting one another...
The public calls him a useless figurehead of a president,
but in truth, he is highly ambitious and skilled at intrigue.
He was the one who devised the invasion of York and secured its approval.
His target was York's summoning facility. He intended to use it
to summon people like Touya and gain their power.
Grad's wife and Kururu's mother.
A strong-willed woman with the strength of both a mother and a woman.
She looks so young for her age that she and Kururu
could almost pass for sisters.
Apparently, the secret is a regular routine
and long, relaxing baths in hot springs.
An arms dealer who prefers a world torn by war.
Dr. Baio's younger brother, and the sponsor
of his Armored Mech development.
A true merchant of death, he believes business knows no borders.
Apparently, he also supplies the terrorist group Dawn of an Era.
Though he seems to enjoy teasing his older brother,
he truly wishes for his happiness.
Bio's secretary and mistress.
A sexy young woman.
Apparently, she is also a talented hacker,
though this has not been confirmed.
Derock's fiancee, who belongs to La=Dis. They have known each other
since childhood, and her good looks are famous in the neighborhood.
Frankly, this cute beauty is far too good for Derock.
Why she would marry him is considered Agarthia's greatest mystery
Chairman of the Agarthian Council.
With his wide connections and excellent intelligence network, he manages
negotiations with other countries.
In a council rife with misuse of public money, corporate collusion,
and cushy jobs for former officials, he is called the last voice of reason.
His honest convictions and conduct make him unpopular in the council,
but few people could keep it functioning properly without his skill.
Since those few are also friendly toward Dei,
nobody openly shows a desire to oppose him.
Dei himself has little faith in the many councilors concerned only with their own interests,
and pushes ahead with reforms of his own.
At the same time, he was also the leader of the terrorist organization
Dawn of an Era. Another being dwelt within him:
Debish's disembodied consciousness. Now that Debish has awakened,
Dei's own existence disappears.
He met Touya at their high school entrance ceremony,
and a certain incident led them to become close friends.
Though he looks like a gentle, handsome young man, he apparently had a wild past.
Not that there is the slightest trace
of it left now.
He is always smiling and treats everyone kindly,
and never boasts about his good looks,
there may even be fan clubs for him not only at his own school
but at other schools, too... Yet with Touya alone,
he turns into an irreverent joker with no sense of restraint.
He is actually a devoted fan of robot anime. He firmly believes that laboratories
beneath Mount Fuji and Mount Asama are building giant robots,
ready for the day someone says, "I prepared this in case something like this happened!"
Only Touya and Kasumi know about this...
The newly appointed teacher of Touya's class.
Apparently, her family has produced generations of Shinto priests,
and she herself has served as a shrine maiden.
Her hobby is long-distance swimming. Her specialties are divination using yin-yang and the five elements,
and sake tasting, limited to local brews.
A child at the orphanage supported by Barkin,
a member of the terrorist group Dawn of an Era. Nicknamed Rii.
Rii is always together with Rudi and Demi,
close friends raised in the same orphanage.
A clingy crybaby who looks up to Barkin as a father.
Rii loves stuffed Uluus toys, modeled after a bearlike creature.
Rii is eagerly waiting for the stuffed Uluus
that Barkin promised to bring.
Unaware that the promise will never be kept...
A computerized camera owned by Maki,
the freelance journalist. Only five exist in the world.
Official designation: 03K-01. Made in Agarthia.
Reisuke is its nickname.
Microphone, lights, arms, theatrical smoke,
125x zoom, infrared camera, night-vision camera,
hovering with retractable legs, walking, diving,
language comprehension, a perpetual-motion engine, and much more.
Quite an impressive piece of equipment.
A member of the Agarthian Council.
A daughter of one of Agarthia's most distinguished noble families.
Until about ten years ago, she was famous
in Agarthian high society for her bewitching beauty.
What happened over those ten years is a mystery,
but she is now a mere shadow of her former self.
A member of the Agarthian Council.
A typical politician.
Nothing more, nothing less.
A member of the Agarthian Council.
Handsome, impeccably educated, and of faultless birth:
the scion of a distinguished noble family.
Usually reserved and quiet, he hides a fierce fire
in his heart that few people know about.
A child at the orphanage supported by Barkin,
a member of the terrorist group Dawn of an Era. Nicknamed Rudi.
He is always together with Demi and Rii,
close friends raised in the same orphanage.
The older-brother figure of the trio, he is quick to fight.
Yet he never uses violence needlessly: he helps the weak
and stands up to the strong.
A child at the orphanage supported by Barkin,
a member of the terrorist group Dawn of an Era. Nicknamed Demi.
He is always together with Rudi and Rii,
close friends raised in the same orphanage.
Though a little laid-back, he has surprising courage
and makes calm judgments.
As a result, no child can match him and Rudi as a team.
In fact, he is the child Barkin's younger sister brought there,
and Demitt Kaimon is not his real name.
That truth will not be known for some time yet...
A colonel in the Republic of Zigrim's army.
He and Growster have fought together since their days as junior officers.
Always at Growster's side,
he provides support in everything from planning operations
to negotiations with all manner of people.
Married. His wife is apparently pregnant, but...
His wife safely gives birth to healthy babies.
Apparently, they are twins.
In the end, his name was never revealed.
A veteran knight of York and an old comrade of Captain Roa.
He also taught swordsmanship to Garyud in his younger days.
Though apparently, rather than teaching combat techniques,
he taught him the proper mindset.
An alchemist who admires Ymir, affectionately calling her
"My dear big sister Ymir!"
She is no less brilliant than Ymir.
Her natural tendency to look down on others, her haughtiness, and her hatred of losing,
combined with others' envy of her talent,
often earn her the whispered nickname "Ymir the Second."
Yet in Ymir's presence, she becomes all sweetness,
clinging to her like an entirely different person.
In truth, she is the sort who works hard where nobody can see.
She clashes with Fain over one thing after another.
A girl whose trademarks are thick, swirly glasses
and a strange device carried on her back.
For some reason, Murk values her talents and employs her as his personal assistant.
Though not officially an alchemist, she has taught herself
the same body of knowledge. Perhaps she is a gifted student
whose talents come from hard work. Murk has never once called her by name,
which bothers her quite a bit.
Sure enough, she was beautiful without her glasses.
How she later succeeds Murk
and causes still more trouble is a story for another time...
Chancellor of York.
He has a nervous-looking face and usually behaves
like a gentleman, but in truth...
A treacherous villain who conspired with Zigrim
in a scheme to make Queen Alforina his own.
Once his life began rolling downhill,
there was no stopping it...
He is probably thinking, "This wasn't supposed to happen!"
A mech kept under supervision and studied in the Holy Land.
Because its power was so immense and so poorly understood,
it was sealed behind the Frail Barrier,
which has the property of absorbing Prana.
During Rayode's assault, however, the barrier broke,
and it appeared before the public for the first time in 29 years.
Data "borrowed" by Celica
played an important role in the creation of the Spirit Mechs.
In a sense, this mech was the foundation from which they were developed.
Though some of its workings have been explained,
much about it remains unknown.
It is currently being repaired after sustaining damage in battle with Rayode.
Apart from changing its color from black to white, its appearance
is unchanged. Internally, however, original components designed by Celica
and other additions have improved its potential.
Its main pilot is Touya Kazami.
For some reason, it cannot be activated unless he is paired
with a female pilot.
It was actually one of the Ze=Ode units.
Surprisingly sturdy, considering its complex transformation mechanism.
Since it has a perpetual-motion engine, it assumes this form
purely in pursuit of speed.
One of the Spirit Mechs built
under the Spirit Mech Development Project.
True to its name, crimson is
its signature color.
Its great strength and mobility make it excellent at close combat.
Some armor has been sacrificed to increase its mobility.
Its pilot is Guo Xiujian.
Incidentally, Hongshenguang, meaning Crimson Flash,
was the name Xiujian gave it himself.
One of the Spirit Mechs built
under the Spirit Mech Development Project.
It mainly uses ranged attacks, but can also hold its own
in close combat. Its overall defenses are average, but the rear armor
has been reinforced.
Its pilot is Melissa Gould.
One of the Spirit Mechs built
under the Spirit Mech Development Project.
An all-round machine that specializes in close combat
while also handling long-range attacks.
Its pilot is Touya Kazami.
Its pilot is Genzbariored Mercene.
One of the Spirit Mechs built
under the Spirit Mech Development Project.
Its form resembles a European knight.
Its pilot is Fain Jin Barion.
One of the Spirit Mechs built
under the Spirit Mech Development Project.
With excellent firepower and mobility,
it excels at ranged combat.
As a result, its defenses still leave
room for improvement.
Its pilot is Aurelie Pandavoine.
One of the Spirit Mechs built
under the Spirit Mech Development Project.
It specializes in ranged combat and has heavy armor.
That thick armor comes at the expense of mobility, however.
Its weapons are powerful but produce heavy recoil,
so it has a tail-like third leg
to improve stability.
Its pilot is Clovis Camillion.
One of the Spirit Mechs built
under the Spirit Mech Development Project.
Its nonhumanoid form is designed to bring out its flying capabilities.
It is mainly effective at ground attacks.
Its pilot is Melvi Clasio.
Its pilot is Kururu Burgley.
One of the Spirit Mechs built
under the Spirit Mech Development Project.
A design that pushes mobility and ranged combat to their limits,
at the cost of thin armor and considerable vulnerability.
It is specialized exclusively for support attacks.
Its pilot is Ai Tennoji.
One of the Spirit Mechs built
under the Spirit Mech Development Project.
Designed for close- and medium-range combat.
It is comparatively well balanced.
Its pilot is Arthur Nkomo.
One of the Spirit Mechs built
under the Spirit Mech Development Project.
Developed primarily for support attacks.
Though relatively versatile among Spirit Mechs,
it is fundamentally a support unit and poor at close combat.
Its pilot is Kasumi Suoh.
Built as a prototype before
the Spirit Mech Development Project began.
Though lightly armed, it was assigned to back up the other Spirit Mechs
at Celica's suggestion.
It has a Repair ability
that restores a unit's HP.
Its pilot is Celica Laniard Mestina.
An Armored Mech created in conjunction with Zigrim's human enhancement project,
commonly known as Code 3.
It uses a special mechanism that became the basis
for Agarthia's new Prana Regulator, achieving an output
far beyond an ordinary Armored Mech's.
It also has a system that converts tension and fighting spirit into Prana,
though it feeds on the pilot's life force.
At full operation, the pilot requires no rest,
and the mech uses Prana to mitigate wear throughout its systems,
allowing it to fight virtually without end.
It carries a remotely controlled floating gun platform on each shoulder and its back,
enabling unpredictable attacks.
This particular unit, however, is a copy of the original,
secretly commissioned by President Horem,
and is considerably unstable.
An obsolete Armored Mech once used mainly in Agarthia.
Left behind by advances in technology,
it naturally withdrew from frontline service.
Though its weapons have been strengthened, it was never
intended to fight other Armored Mechs,
making it ill-suited to combat.
In York, it is used rather like construction machinery
and remains in active service... perhaps?
An older-generation Armored Mech.
The basis for Agarthia's standard Armored Mechs.
Because it can be built at relatively low cost,
it has been produced in large numbers and used throughout the country.
An older-generation Armored Mech.
Its main role is rear support.
An older-generation Armored Mech.
It has a nonhumanoid form because its design prioritizes flight.
Used for air superiority and ground attacks.
A general-purpose Armored Mech for commanders in the Agarthian Army.
It was designed to surpass York's Art Wesper
in performance.
To meet its requirements, the mech inevitably grew larger,
and production costs rose with it.
It had to be removed from the mass-production program. The effort paid off,
however, as it did meet the required performance standards.
Though classed as an older-generation machine, this Secti-based mech
has been tuned and upgraded repeatedly,
giving it capabilities equal or superior to newer-generation Armored Mechs.
Famous as the machine piloted by Rest Jin Benish, the Phoenix Knight,
it is counted among the continent's Four Great Armored Mechs.
Secretly developed at Marshal Revios's orders as the Agarthian Army's
next-generation mass-production mech.
It excels at close combat and boasts extraordinary fighting ability.
Despite incorporating a range of new technologies, cost issues
led to mass production being shelved.
As a result, the prototype became Lieutenant Colonel Selg's
personal machine. Like Renbardon, it uses a new Prana Regulator,
allowing even ordinary Agarthians
to draw out a substantial measure of power,
successfully bringing it up to the level of a Spirit Mech.
Built as a testbed for a plasma diffusion barrier.
Installing the plasma barrier generator
made it far larger than conventional Armored Mechs.
Development was abandoned because of its high operating costs,
but Colonel Geel later modified it.
Secretly developed at Marshal Revios's orders as the Agarthian Army's
next-generation mass-production mech.
Learning from Secti's shortcomings, the development plan prioritized
ease of production. As a result, it avoided risky new technologies,
limiting improvements to stronger weapons
and a modest increase in output. Even so, its new Prana Regulator
allows even ordinary Agarthians
to draw out a substantial measure of power,
successfully bringing it up to the level of a Spirit Mech.
Designed exclusively for the royal family as part
of the Agarthian Army's next-generation Armored Mech program.
Its new Prana Regulator, combined with the royal family's high Prana,
successfully raised its performance to a level capable
of surpassing even a Spirit Mech.
A small craft flown by the journalist Maki. Like a flying car,
it uses antigravitons to fly. About the size of a large passenger car,
it is highly maneuverable. Maki uses it to travel far and wide
in search of stories. It has a machine gun for self-defense,
but it is utterly ineffective against Armored Mechs. Recording cameras
and other equipment are mounted all over it.
A fixed long-range defensive gun emplacement used throughout Agarthia.
It has high firepower and long range, but cannot respond
to enemies at close quarters.
A fixed Vulcan Phalanx anti-aircraft emplacement, also used
to defend bases throughout Agarthia.
A fixed anti-Armored Mech missile emplacement, also used
to defend bases throughout Agarthia.
A general-purpose transport craft used across Agarthia.
Its large carrying capacity and long cruising range
have made it useful throughout the world.
Slow-moving, but durable.
The Armored Mech piloted by Garyud Via Vratzen, the continent's strongest knight,
who bears the title Sword Radiance, Phantom Saint.
The machine itself was passed down by the previous Sword Radiance holder,
but its internal systems have been perfectly tuned for Garyud.
Conversely, nobody else can activate it.
When it was built, or by whom, is unknown.
As it bears no maker's mark, one thing is certain:
it was not made by anyone recognized as a master craftsman.
Yet its performance surpasses every other Armored Mech.
It is even said that no machine can defeat Bosendorfer
in single combat. Its distinctive features are
the lion-shaped shield on its left arm and an enormous broadsword.
The first unit of the Art Wesper, a masterpiece representing
the culmination of York's Armored Mech technology.
Though the same model as Brandeim and Almaris, it uses experimental
special-metal armor. Compared with the other two,
it achieves a reduction in weight without sacrificing performance.
When its silver body races across the battlefield,
its gallant form inspires allies and fills enemies
with terror at the approaching danger.
Famous as the machine piloted by Reduce Ren Chromehearts,
one of the Three Sword Knights.
The second unit of the Art Wesper, a masterpiece representing
the culmination of York's Armored Mech technology.
Though the same model as Ragrade and Almaris,
it has an assist function added to its Prana transmission system,
giving it greater output than the other two.
Piloted by Tyron Ren Arsdaluar of the Three Sword Knights.
A masterpiece representing the culmination of York's Armored Mech technology.
Compared with the Ragrade and Brandeim of the same model,
it has no single outstanding feature,
but can instead be called a well-balanced machine.
Piloted by Ciel Ren Vratzen of the Three Sword Knights.
A landship reserved for York's royal family.
Used to escape Flamuelk Castle with Queen Alforina,
who had been put to sleep by Oswald.
Naturally, it has no weapons and only weak armor.
It is not particularly fast, either.
Its sinister silhouette calls a demon to mind.
Given a central role among the Ze=Ode units,
it possesses immense power.
Its sword, bearing the name "Holy," has the power to free anything
from the chains of this mortal world.
Its pilot is Bafred Debish.
Weak at close combat, but more than makes up for it
with powerful armor and long-range attacks.
Its front bears a relief of a woman,
almost like a woman imprisoned in stone.
When Parthenos unleashes its true power,
a light of judgment rains down and sweeps everything away.
Its pilot is Sharl Debish.
A mech with somewhat feminine contours.
In this form, it cannot exert as much power
as the other Ze=Ode units,
but makes up for it by bewildering its enemies with agile movements.
Its pilot is Leone.
The core body is housed in its chest. The form currently visible
is an auxiliary unit.
Since every Ze=Ode unit can move between points by warping, however,
